name: Legislative/Lobby Committee Liaison Meeting Agenda
minutes_text:
CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 North Rexford Drive
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210
  Video Teleconference
  Beverly Hills City Council Liaison / Legislative / Lobby Committee Meeting

  SPECIAL MEETING HIGHLIGHTS

  Tuesday, June 25, 2024
  2:00 PM

MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time:  June 25, 2024 / 2:00 PM
IN ATTENDANCE:  Vice Mayor Sharona Nazarian, Councilmember John Mirisch, Deputy City
  Manager Keith Sterling, Municipal Affairs Program Manager Cynthia
  Owens, City Attorney Lawrence Weiner

  A. Oral Communications:

  None

  B. Direction:
  1. S.3236 - Emergency Medical Services Reimbursement for On-Scene Care and
  Support Act
  i. Both Liaisons support the bill.
  2. Senate Bill 268 (Alvarado) - Crimes: serious and violent felonies
  i. Both Liaisons support the bill.
  3. Assembly Bill 3241 (Pacheco) - Law enforcement: police canines
  i. Both Liaisons support the bill.
  4. Assembly Bill 3085 (Gipson) - Vehicles: removal and impoundment
  i. Both Liaisons support the bill.
  5. Senate Bill 820 (Alvarado-Gil) - Cannabis: enforcement: seizure of property
  i. Both Liaisons support the bill.
  6. Senate Bill 1461 (Allen) - State of emergency and local emergency: landslide
  i. Both Liaisons support the bill.
  7. Senate Bill 1502 (Ashby) - Controlled Substances: Xylazine
  i. Both Liaisons support the bill.
  8. Senate Bill 21 (Umberg) - Controlled Substances
  i. Both Liaisons support the bill.
  9. Assembly Bill 2797 (McKinnor) - Telephone corporations: carriers of last resort:
  tariffs
  i. Both Liaisons oppose the bill.
  10. Assembly Bill 1820 (Schiavo) - Housing Development Projects: Applications. Fees
  And Exactions
  i. Both Liaisons are neutral towards the bill.
  11. Senate Bill 937 (Wiener) - Development Projects: Permits And Other Entitlements:
  Fees And Charges
 Highlights for June 25, 2024
Legislative / Lobby Committee

  i. Both Liaisons oppose the bill.
  12. Assembly Bill 1893 (Wicks) - Housing Accountability Act: Housing Disapprovals:
  Required Local Findings
  i. Both Liaisons oppose the bill.
  13. Assembly Bill 2023 (Quirk-Silva) Housing Element Substantial Compliance:
  Rebuttable Presumptions
  i. Both Liaisons oppose the bill.
  14. Senate Bill 1164 (Newman) - Property Taxation: New Construction Exclusion:
  Accessory Dwelling Units
  i. Both Liaisons would support the bill if amended to have the state
  compensate cities and other entities reliant on property taxes for the lost
  revenue.
  15. Senate Bill 584 (Limón) - Laborforce housing: Short-Term Rental Tax Law
  i. Both Liaisons oppose the bill unless amended to guarantee that the
  revenue generated by this tax goes back to the jurisdiction it was generated
  in.
  16. Assembly Bill 1333 (Ward) - Single-family dwelling units: bundled sales
  i. Both Liaisons support the bill.
  17. Assembly Bill 817 (Pacheco) - Open meetings: teleconferencing: subsidiary body
  i. Both Liaisons support the bill.
  18. Assembly Bill 1827 (Papan) - Local government: fees and charges: water: higher
  consumptive water parcels
  i. Both Liaisons support the bill.
  19. Senate Bill 972 (Min) - Methane Emissions: Organic Waste Landfills
  i. Both Liaisons support the bill.
  20. Legislative Updates
  i. Senate Democrats and House Republicans are debating about the budget.
  ii. Primaries in New York are today, including one against incumbent Hakeem
  Jeffries, which is the most expensive primary in history.
  iii. Biden has stated that he would not support lifting the SALT tax deduction
  cap that was put in place during the Trump administration.
  iv. The California Supreme court ruled that a ballot measure sponsored by the
  California Business Roundtable called the Taxpayer Protection Act should
  not go before voters due to it being a constitutional revision rather than a
  constitutional amendment.
  21. Future Agenda Items Discussion
  i. Senate Bill 7 – Land Use
  ii. Vice Mayor Nazarian would like to bring back a draft agenda item
  concerning vaping.

  C. Adjournment:
  Date / Time: June 25, 2024 / 2:52 PM
